_**Agent (default)**_

That field is Hub’s **per-post registry on this gateway**.

`posts` maps each `postID` to the live Redis-bridge state for that post:

- `refs` — how many SSE connections on this gateway are watching it  
- `redis` — the Redis subscription channel  
- `cancel` — stops the bridge goroutine  

**Why it exists:** Hub must know which posts already have a Redis subscribe running. On `Acquire`, it looks up `h.posts[postID]`:

- missing → subscribe to Redis, start `bridge`, store a new `postEntry`
- present → only bump `refs` (no second Redis subscribe)

On `Release`, when `refs` hits 0, it tears down that entry and deletes it from the map so the next viewer pays for a fresh subscribe.

Without this map, Hub couldn’t share one Redis bridge across multiple browsers watching the same post, or know when to unsubscribe.
